title: Cryptography to speak with angelic beings: Trithemius, Dee and Kelley

tellings.quote: >> Yeah. Or like the first cryptographers like Trimus 13th century was like always like cryptography in order to speak to these sort of angelic beings

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that some of the first codemakers in Europe, like Johannes Trithemius, a German monk and scholar, used secret codes in order to speak with angel-like beings, and he places this, by his telling, in the 13th century. The story is tied to John Dee, an English scholar and adviser at the royal court, and his partner Edward Kelley, who said they talked with angels. Michels raises it as a sign that contact with non-human beings may be a very old human thread.
